name: One-Arm Kettlebell Swings
instructions: Perform the movement with control through a full range of motion.
Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, resting as needed between sets.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: One-Arm Kettlebell Swings is an intermediate hip-hinge exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed with a kettlebell. The hinge is the foundation of safe lifting — it teaches you to load the hips, not the spine.
